8613b699260ed52e193f33b41141be4d73e79e93.LogDescription: Travel to the Den of Haal'esh in Hellfire Peninsula and search the Kaliri Nests for a Female Kaliri Hatchling.  Use the Empty Birdcage to capture it and bring it to Falconer Drenna Riverwind at Falcon Watch.
8613b699260ed52e193f33b41141be4d73e79e93.QuestDescription: The Haal'eshi arakkoa have domesticated a beautiful bird species called the kaliri.$B$BI've managed to capture a young male and they appear to be trainable.  The females are much rarer, but if I had one I could attempt to breed them.  She has to be young, though... a hatchling.  An older wild bird wouldn't survive in captivity.$B$BTake this cage and travel south, to the Den of Haal'esh.  Search the nests for eggs that are ready to hatch.  If you bring me back a female hatchling, I'll reward you handsomely.

8619b6e223fd8ecc500a3fe5e631fd8884bcfdcc.Text: I can't follow the tracers back out, too many flesh beasts in the way. Send someone in... Follow the tracers... Ya-six, out.

861c43a6f128c4d3d1f1b507eaba9f29a5b040ca.QuestDescription: From what scouting we have managed to muster, we believe that the foe south of the gnolls is an insect-like race.  Frankly, it is irrelevant whether or not if they're sentient.  If they are driving the gnolls to frenzy against us, then they are as big of a threat - if not more - than the gnolls.$B$BDrive deep into where these Zukk'ash insects dwell; it is known as the Writhing Deep.  Thin their numbers and report back to me what you find, bringing back their carapaces as evidence of your handiwork.

861c83283cdb4cf08a1a0254f59eafc98452d2d7.Text: Maintaining this barrier will require all of my concentration. Kill them all!

861f07664779d49dd265fef6a2108ad6357dd9d3.CompletionText: The watches of Andorhal, much like the large clock on the ruins of the town hall, all are frozen in time at three o'clock.  This was when the full effects of the plague first spread out over the city, choking the life out of it.$B$BAs much as we all may regret what happened that day, it has shaped the flow of time as you mortals perceive it.  The bronze dragonflight must persevere in protecting the timeline!

8621e58497d4c0c1a2b3d2560095b86f9a9207d1.LogDescription: Speak with Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in Ravenholdt Manor.
8621e58497d4c0c1a2b3d2560095b86f9a9207d1.QuestDescription: Lord Jorach Ravenholdt has requested your presence.  The matter is secret, and I cannot say any more.$b$bRavenholdt Manor is located in the Hillsbrad Foothills -- look for a path in the mountains northwest of Durnhold Keep.

Use him to slay 200 Scourge Minions, Bythius the Flesh-Shaper, Urgreth of the Thousand Tombs and Hailscorn.$B$BSpeak to the Avatar of Freya in Sholazar Basin when you've completed this task.
86281ae9d5a12c0ab0029264d550d4e0481e8f79.QuestDescription: It is time, $N.  The Etymidian is one of the most destructive forces ever created by the titans and I am loathe to unleash him in my lands.$B$BThere is little choice, however.  Our enemies have forced my hand and the fury of the titans will cleanse all.

86323a515e00332ceaa326dad064adfa9be1b989.LogDescription: Kill 4 Razormane Quilboars, 4 Razormane Scouts, 4 Razormane Dustrunners and 4 Razormane Battleguards for Gar'Thok at Razor Hill.
86323a515e00332ceaa326dad064adfa9be1b989.QuestDescription: When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.$b$bIt has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. Their camps can be found to the west of here. Look for the brambles and you will find them. Today we drive them from Durotar, tomorrow, perhaps from all of Kalimdor.

parent_quests.LogDescription: Kill Lord Jaraxxus.$B$BThis quest can be completed with any difficulty or size raid.
parent_quests.QuestDescription: Archmage Timear has foreseen a horrible event, which is about to transpire. A foolish gnome warlock is about to accidentally summon an Eredar lord of the Burning Legion into the middle of the Trial of the Crusader.$B$BYou must be there when it happens, $c. If Lord Jaraxxus escapes, he will open a portal and the Burning Legion will spill forth into our world once more.$B$BThe Council of Six has decreed that Lord Jaraxxus must die!

parent_speech.Text: Trifling gnome! Your arrogance will be your undoing!
You face Jaraxxus, Eredar Lord of the Burning Legion!
Come forth, sister! Your master calls!

8658e5d01aabff2877fe7b571015571db1e33ca9.LogDescription: Lieutenant Icehammer in the Howling Fjord wants you to place the Alliance Banner in Baleheim and then defend the banner against attackers.$B$BReturn to Lieutenant Icehammer with the Alliance Banner should you survive.
8658e5d01aabff2877fe7b571015571db1e33ca9.QuestDescription: I'm not about to put the fate of this mission into the hands of some untested scrub.$B$BNow, if you want to prove to me that you've got what it takes to carry out this mission, you'll need to do what I tell you.$B$BTake this battle standard and head over to Baleheim, directly north of here. Once you're at Baleheim, find the center of town and drop our flag. Fight off any vrykul dirt bags that attempt to take down our beloved flag and return to me once you've established Alliance dominance!

865d054c4577fac14e30be69a48dd76c8a21203c.comment: Deviate Creeper - In Combat - Cast 'Infected Wound'

865dfd75dbc67c54c18baefc833d33435fadffef.RewardText: Ah, yes, Dertrok. We spoke briefly about the arakkoa. I must say that our... interests in them vary quite significantly.

86604ddf520555a4244345b338ab2570c3b0f9b6.RewardText: You've gained my utmost respect today, $N.$B$BSlaying one fel orc is not an easy task. Massacring a score of them is, well... heroic.

866ed3e6b73aefae60f3ea8d292577e16ddcb2ce.RewardText: A thousand years has passed and just as it was fated, one stands before me. One who shall lead their people to a new age.$B$BThe Old God trembles, $N. Oh yes, it fears your faith. Shatter the prophecy of C'Thun.$B$BIt knows you come, champion - and with you comes the might of Kalimdor. You have only to let me know when you are prepared and I shall grant you the Scepter of the Shifting Sands.

8675d23f27598a760f9df55bbed0a50333e23ebe.comment: Twilights Hammer Torturer - In Combat - Cast Shadow Word: Pain

8678d6e4645b8315bc300d3ec4f918fcad03ca60.LogDescription: Arygos in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj will create Elementium Infused Armaments for you should you bring him Imperial Qiraji Armaments and 3 Elementium Ore.
8678d6e4645b8315bc300d3ec4f918fcad03ca60.QuestDescription: We have not sat idly by for a millennium, $N.$B$BWe have watched these beasts feast on their own when they have exhausted their utility. We have listened as they have plotted and schemed to destroy our world. And we have learned of their own internal treachery.$B$BWeaknesses exist and we know how to use those weaknesses to our advantage.$B$BFind and bring me their ceremonial armaments: Combined with the element created from the volatility of their own God, they will become a force of reckoning.

867b1fa3b841c30d8e1ada6f1529d8635c4b3bb6.RewardText: <Scout Vor'takh smiles.>$B$BThor Modan is on the verge of collapse, then?$B$BVery well. We will soon turn our attention to Dun Argol.

867c3a5a37d9261fd417edcd305eb8d853a1dab2.comment: Silverbrook Villager - Between 0-50% Health - Cast 'Worgen Transform' (No Repeat)

867d1a10dde7cefb1ead933a4ce076478c7c0ae9.Text: Do you like what we've done here? Perhaps we will drop these crystals from the sky all over Outland.

86829dae171271cbecb33319e393204c6b92be30.RewardText: You've brightened my day, $c. When I die, I will make sure it's in the battlefield... covered in the blood of my opponents and taking them down with me.

868827af7833714b2b0a576cfc5d987d6d2cded4.comment: Aqueous Surger - In Combat - Cast 'Poison Bolt Volley' (No Repeat) (Normal Dungeon)

868c08cb1502c9d0bca1098701516fe239950fb8.Text: Dajik tried to show me ways of hunt, but I do better when I do things my way.

868def8299d66f64a18d04cd02f40b005d4c8f7d.LogDescription: Summon Omen, defeat him and gain Elune's Blessing.  Return to Valadar Starsong in Nighthaven
868def8299d66f64a18d04cd02f40b005d4c8f7d.QuestDescription: The beast Omen was once a hero of this world.  A wolf of great strength and fortune, Omen fought beside the heroes of the War of the Ancients until he succumbed to demonic magics.  Turning against his allies, he raged across Azeroth and carried death and terror in his wake.$B$BFinally defeated here, in Moonglade, Omen now sleeps among the silt of Lake Elune'ara.  But each new year, during the festival, he stirs...$B$BGather cohorts, $N, and summon and defeat the beast Omen.  Earn the blessing of Elune!

8691a32b93694309146c4c3612b8417489b09a0f.LogDescription: Return two Huge Citrines, two Dark Jade and two Shadow Crystals to Alestros in Valiance Keep.
8691a32b93694309146c4c3612b8417489b09a0f.QuestDescription: There's a war going on and we each must do our part!  Mine is cutting gems and not only can I cut normal gems but I have the skill to cut perfect gems as well.   If you can bring me several uncut gems to contribute to the cause, I can teach you gem perfection as well.   This will allow you to sometimes cut a perfect gem with increased bonuses when cutting a uncommon quality gem from Northrend.

86938fec7195d35fedc4fca462bf686d91b15d67.Text: You cannot hide from us, little paladin!

86944bee26774047d0a56262e6bebf3fcc94737c.comment: Skethyl Owl - Between 20-80% Health - Cast '38254' (No Repeat)

86976738b29eff4d6996cf7903aee1099dc41a9c.LogDescription: Gnomus at Wildhammer Stronghold in Shadowmoon Valley wants you to recover 8 Felfire Spleens.
86976738b29eff4d6996cf7903aee1099dc41a9c.QuestDescription: Have you ever heard of food that cooks itself and stays hot forever? Dare to dream, I say!$B$BBut maybe it's not a dream at all! Outside the fortress, near the lava pools and streams, you can find beasts that thrive in the sizzling heat. They're called felfire diemetradons.$B$BThe dwarves around here tell me that those diemetradons have the tastiest spleens ever and that the spleens practically come pre-cooked! Bring me those spleens and I'll give you some coin.$B$BStart your search directly east of here.

869a2db39b0ed151c54294bfec32428cbda1114d.comment: Grel'borg the Miser - In Combat - Cast 'Quick Flame Ward' (No Repeat)

869a89afa84826c0cda1fc0f7170e06a45e6398a.LogDescription: Defeat 10 enemy players in Halaa and return to Karrtog in Garadar.
869a89afa84826c0cda1fc0f7170e06a45e6398a.QuestDescription: Our ancient enemy, the draenei, have returned with powerful allies.  They wage war in Halaa, southwest of here.$B$BWe cannot allow them a victory there as Garadar would be next without a doubt.$B$BGo and slay those who would aid our ancient enemy.

869b7ad8fb049e58d67b9ca5d061ee97ecaf94cb.CompletionText: Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.$B$B..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!$B$BWhat I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.$B$BSo, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?

869d1d2ad958e7f0f2059eb0464d59dec3964dd0.QuestDescription: I thinkin' it be time to do some scalpin', mon!$B$BThe trolls at Heb'Drakkar to the northeast should do nicely. With their fancy bats and attackin' us, they got it comin'!$B$BAhunae even give you his own knife so that you do the job right.

I'm sure they're eager to use them on the ore deposits of Loch Modan.$B$BThank you for your help, $N. I am in your debt, but I hope this money will at least cover your travel costs.

86a102ac9de3be93477dacc2701126ec9e47082a.RewardText: Thank goodness! I wouldn't be able to serve the feast without spice bread stuffing.

86a3f96f2d6e7af6fa52b611d4fdce7b61686250.LogDescription: Krakle in Un'Goro Crater wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge.$B$BWhenever you find a hot spot, right click the thermometer to check the temperature. Keep looking until you find the hottest one.
86a3f96f2d6e7af6fa52b611d4fdce7b61686250.QuestDescription: The hot springs here are a source of mystery to me. Where does the heat come from?$B$BLooking at how close the pools are to Fire Plume Ridge, I really wonder if the volcano might have something to do with it. I created a thermometer to take readings of the temperatures at the volcano, and I'd like to find the hottest part. It gives the measurements in degrees Kraklenheit!$B$BHere, take it, and take readings of the temperatures at the ridge whenever you see a hot spot!

86a60292b919caf7ed9e2fc23f3a7d112e9ba1de.OptionText: I'd like a new invitation to the Lunar Festival.

86a8a9f88c9f9412121fdbaa7590d499ffea3d16.Text: Nae, that's fer wimps. Hit me with yer hammer!

86abfe949d9e68658f22c7967ae87a34e6b4656c.Text: The Scarlet Crusade shall smite the wicked and drive evil from these lands!

86ace25ff43fcc324cd3694906df495b353daae8.LogDescription: Commander Lynore Windstryke at Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight wants you to kill 20 Scarlet Onslaught at the Onslaught Base Camp.
86ace25ff43fcc324cd3694906df495b353daae8.QuestDescription: To the northeast of Wintergarde Keep is a newly built encampment, set up by the Scarlet Crusade - or rather - the Scarlet Onslaught as they now call themselves. While we are unsure as to why they are in Northrend, they are certainly no less dangerous than they were before. As of last night the Scarlet Onslaught has killed twelve of our soldiers. They must be taught a lesson, $N.$B$BGo to Onslaught Base Camp and thin them out. $B

86ae88a5293c8ac9c2fcebb7fb2ffaa61b2ac583.LogDescription: Speak to Saern Priderunner again to learn the Plainsrunning skill.
86ae88a5293c8ac9c2fcebb7fb2ffaa61b2ac583.QuestDescription: Imagine yourself racing across the plains,through forests and over mountains,the wind in your face... Traveling over unseen territory; the wonder of the road ahead,your destiny resting just over the horizon.$B$BAlways remember that on hoof,many things are achievable; as a Tauren,you will be granted the swiftness of Plainsrunning. There is no limit to the distances you might go.

86aefaaea2691c86d163ae0d4f292fef32e2a012.comment: Razormane Battleguard - In Combat - Cast 'Improved Blocking' (No Repeat)

86af1b264d5b288fb8a8bc3c0090eebe1a5a6665.Text: Intruders!  The Hammer shall fall upon you.

86b01c0061b0ed2c7a9aa02dbb032d2f4231c5e2.RewardText: That's enough for today. Slow and steady is the key here. Too much disruption and they'd turn their attention directly upon us; something that we don't want.$b$bCome back again tomorrow and we'll work on it some more.

86b47def5f0c465eeb18d8af133de356938b6976.LogDescription: Lieutenant Dawnrunner at the Farstrider Retreat in Eversong Woods wants you to kill 5 Amani Berserkers and 5 Amani Axe Throwers.
86b47def5f0c465eeb18d8af133de356938b6976.QuestDescription: Ours are not the vast kingdoms of the humans and orcs.  All we have left of our lands in Azeroth lies mostly before your eyes, $N.$B$BUntil we can reach Outland, we must defend what little land we have at any cost.$B$BOur uncivilized neighbors to the southeast, the Amani trolls, certainly have a different opinion regarding the ownership of these lands.  Their daily raids are something we can't tolerate anymore.  Go to their settlements, Zeb'Watha and Tor'Watha, and teach them a lesson.

86b6bec71f44a4aea289b5a1fd6cbbba47b2fde5.Text: The march upon the Undercity begins now! Be empowered by your King's strength! Follow me, heroes! FOR THE GLORY OF THE ALLIANCE!
